issue.title: Weekday Expo compatibility sync job
issue.body:
## Parent

Part of #420 (Phase 2). Do not close #420 from this ticket.

## Problem

`Quality Gates` goes red on `main` — and therefore on every PR branched from it — roughly every three days, with no diff in this repo. The team then hand-runs `npx expo install --fix`, opens a realignment PR, merges it, and re-syncs in-flight branches. That has happened repeatedly (#314, #343, and prior `expo install --fix` commits).

Phase 1 (#425) pinned Node (`.nvmrc`) and lockfile `expo-doctor@1.20.4`, but left two networked steps in `.github/workflows/quality-gates.yml`:

- `npm run doctor` still runs `InstalledDependencyVersionCheck` against Expo’s remote versions map
- `npx expo install --check` still fetches that remote map (`EXPO_OFFLINE` unset)

### Mechanism (verified in `@expo/cli`)

`getVersionedPackages` merges local `bundledNativeModules.json` with the remote SDK versions map (remote wins). `validateDependenciesVersions` reads **installed** versions from `node_modules`, so `~57.0.x` ranges in `package.json` do not decide pass/fail. A frozen `package-lock.json` against a map that advances every ~3 days produces red CI with no repo diff. `expo` itself is remote-only in that map — the primary recurring failure.

## Proposed fix (two layers)

### Layer 1 — deterministic PR gate

- `EXPO_DOCTOR_SKIP_DEPENDENCY_VERSION_CHECK=1` + `EXPO_DOCTOR_WARN_ON_NETWORK_ERRORS=1` on the doctor step (other doctor checks stay blocking).
- `EXPO_OFFLINE=1` on `expo install --check` so it validates against lockfile-pinned `expo/bundledNativeModules.json` only.
- Scripts: `expo:check` (offline, mirrors CI) and `expo:check:latest` (online freshness probe). `doctor` stays the pinned local binary.

### Layer 2 — freshness as a scheduled auto-PR

New `.github/workflows/expo-sdk-align.yml` (`schedule` weekly Monday + `workflow_dispatch`):

1. Checkout `main`; `npm ci`
2. Online `npx expo install --fix` (abort / fail job, open no PR if this fails — see expo/expo#48612)
3. Online full `npm run doctor`
4. Open/update single PR on `chore/expo-sdk-align` via App token or PAT (**not** `GITHUB_TOKEN` — recursion guard would leave required checks like `PR Description` forever waiting)
5. PR body includes Android native rebuild warning: `npm run prebuild` + fresh dev client (`expo-modules-core` / native sources)

Never bump Expo SDK major/minor; abort if `expo` major/minor would change. Ignore gitignored `android/`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `quality-gates.yml` sets `EXPO_OFFLINE=1` on the `expo install --check` step, and `EXPO_DOCTOR_SKIP_DEPENDENCY_VERSION_CHECK=1` + `EXPO_DOCTOR_WARN_ON_NETWORK_ERRORS=1` on the `expo-doctor` step, each with a comment naming this issue.
- [ ] `expo-doctor` remains pinned in `devDependencies` and is invoked via the local binary (`npm run doctor`), not `npx expo-doctor@latest`.
- [ ] `expo:check` runs offline (mirrors CI); `expo:check:latest` runs online for a deliberate freshness probe.
- [ ] Publishing a new `expo` 57.0.x patch upstream no longer turns Quality Gates red with an unchanged tree (offline check passes while online may report newer patches).
- [ ] A deliberately incompatible install (e.g. wrong `react-native-screens`) still fails Quality Gates with `EXPO_OFFLINE=1` — the gate keeps its real value.
- [ ] `expo-sdk-align.yml` exists, runs on `schedule` + `workflow_dispatch`, and opens or updates a single PR on `chore/expo-sdk-align` against `main`.
- [ ] That PR is authored by a GitHub App token or PAT (not `GITHUB_TOKEN`) so required checks actually run and post. Document the secret(s) needed.
- [ ] Auto-PR body includes the `npm run prebuild` + fresh-dev-client warning (Android-only; no CocoaPods).
- [ ] A failed `expo install --fix` fails the scheduled job and opens no PR.
- [ ] `docs/ci.md` workflow table gains the new workflow; Quality Gates row notes offline/deterministic validation with freshness on a schedule.
- [ ] No workflow-level `paths:` filter (the #845 / docs/ci.md guardrail).
- [ ] No branch-protection change required.
- [ ] SHA-pin all new `uses:` (action-pins gate).

## Out of scope

Phase 3 Dependabot ownership (#424), Phase 4 merge queue (#423), Expo SDK 58+.

## References

- Prior Phase 1: #425 / #420
- Manual realignments: #314, #343
- Versions endpoint ahead of npm: https://github.com/expo/expo/issues/48612
